paras: Liolaemus cazianiae is a species of lizard in the family  Liolaemidae. The species is endemic to Argentina.
The specific name, cazianiae (feminine, genitive singular), is in honor of Argentinean ecologist Sandra Caziani (1961–2005).
L. cazianiae is found in Salta Province, Argentina.
The preferred natural habitats of L. cazianiae are shrubland and grassland, at altitudes of 3,485–4,285 m (11,434–14,058 ft).
The diet of L. cazianiae consists of plant material.
